singer.oneLineEn: Equal consideration of interests widens the moral circle; the affluent answer distant suffering with calculable effect.

nussbaum.oneLineEn: A threshold of central capabilities measures justice and joins evaluative emotions to care for vulnerable dignity.

plumwood.oneLineEn: Critiques the reason/nature dualism of domination; ecological reason and prey experience dismantle human exceptionalism.

butler.oneLineEn: Gender is the performative effect of reiterated norms; precarious life opens a politics of recognition and mourning.

hooks.oneLineEn: From intersecting race-class-gender oppression, engaged pedagogy and love become ethical practice against domination.

amo.oneLineEn: Philosophizes African rights in Europe and clarifies mind-body roles by denying sensation to the mind itself.

wiredu.oneLineEn: Conceptual decolonization frees African linguistic resources; consensus democracy replaces adversarial majority rule.

senghor.oneLineEn: Négritude affirms devalued cultural forms and writes rhythm and humanism into African socialism.

hountondji.oneLineEn: Rejects equating African philosophy with ethnic worldviews; endogenous knowledge must face public argument and test.

dewey.oneLineEn: Knowledge is a tool of inquiry tested by consequences; democracy is a way of life of shared experience.
keywordsEn: Democracy as a way of life

quine.oneLineEn: Holism dissolves the analytic-synthetic divide; ontological commitments of a theory are fixed by its quantifiers.

nozick.oneLineEn: Side-constraint rights justify a minimal state; entitlement justice rejects patterned end-state redistribution.

dussel.oneLineEn: Rewrites philosophy from the underside of colonial modernity; victims' life and popular power build a liberation ethics.

zelea.oneLineEn: Lifts Latin American marginal experience into historical consciousness to define universal problems free of dependency.

sor-juana.oneLineEn: Defends women's right to know and public debate; Baroque dream poetics probes the limits of finite intellect.
